hook: A map of a giant proof

beats.say: A new progress map follows the ambitious effort to formalize Alessandro Masullo's manuscript on the Riemann Hypothesis in Lean, the proof-checking language.
It shows, part by part, which sections of the proof have already been checked and which are still waiting.
For a proof of this scale, the map turns an overwhelming formalization effort into something you can watch take shape, piece by piece.
